notes.title: Chamber's Reunion 1.4
notes.content:
Hello guys!

I am happy to say that we just released new version of Chamber's Reunion. There is not much of new content but, still there is some, we added new GUI features, sounds, and short introduction to what happens in the game. So if I was you, I would download the new update and replay this game once again.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 + CHAPTER 2 INFO
notes.content:
CHAPTER ONE
Hello, I am happy to say that new update is here, with this update we added few new things..

GAMEPLAY

 Added new Journal System to help you navigate in the game
 Added a feature to skip the cutscene at the start of the game
 Added a UI overhaul (mainly for Journal System)


BUGS

 Fixed a bug where Enemy Chase would not trigger if player didnt look at the enemy


DISCORD
Also I would like to remind that we have a Discord Server, where you can talk about our games, leave feedback and more..

notes.title: 21/6/24 - Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed issue with placement of character

notes.title: Fixes & Achievements
notes.content:
BUG FIXES

 Fixed a bug, where screen would not fade out after finishing cutscene


ACHIEVEMENTS

 Added four new achievements for you to unlock
 Each achievements is representing a certain moment in gameplay

notes.title: CHAPTER ONE
notes.content:
Hello
We are here to say that today you can play Chapter One. Experience awesome graphics and story telling.

notes.title: BECOMING FREE
notes.content:
Dear Players

We are here to announce that Chamber's Reunion will become free. We decided to split this game into 3 chapters. Currently you can play the first chapter for free in the next few days. We are also currently working on the new chapters, and those ones will be paid, we are planning that both chapters should cost about 5-10$

Q&A
[olist]
 What if I purchased the game before going free? - We take it as support for our little studio, also we are planning on giving those who purchased our game some extra content in some way.
 When we will see another chapter? - We can't say anything yet, but we are working 100% a day, also we are working on some other projects.
 Is there a support for another languagues? - Yes! We currently support: English, Czech. We are also working on other translations such as: Spanish, German, French.
[/olist]

notes.title: Preview 1.3
notes.content:
Hello, after a little longer development the game got a a completly new design. First of all the game has been rebuilded from start on a Unreal Engine 5. In the next few months the game will recive a lot of updates, because this is just a preview.

Controls:

-WSAD - Move
- Mouse - Look around
- E - Enter Vehicle
- Space Bar - Exit Vehicle

notes.title: Chamber's Reunion Update Is Here
notes.content: The Big Update, that you have been waiting for is here, changes to the map, to ai, to player, to items and much more. I am happy to say that the game looks fire, achivements are also fixed and try to get special Speedrun achivements for finishing the game under some time. So what are you waiting for try it now
